{
    "content": "<p>It comes <a href=\"http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/system.net.ftpwebrequest.aspx\">baked\nin</a>. Yay!</p>\n<p>Update: Apparently seeing products that do FTP in .NET for years made me think\nthis wasn't built in. It's been around since .NET 2.0...
